our_title: Context split creates a second random stream regardless of the deterministic option; ordering (and partition) depend on thread count
ran: repro/PS2-G08-2 (series tree, SCOTCH_DETERMINISTIC=1): gord bump.grf differing lines vs 1 thread: 2 threads 3532, 4 threads 6186; gpart 8: 2 threads 0, 4 threads 5646; run-to-run at 2 threads: 0 (reproducible for a fixed thread count). mord cube_8.msh: 0 (not observed on that mesh). With alt a (common_context.c): gord 1==2==4, gpart 2==4 but 1 vs 2 = 829 (residual is bgraphBipartGg's per-thread PRNG, G08's SEP-13). With alt b (hgraph_order_nd.c + hmesh_order_nd.c guards): gord 1==2==4, gpart unchanged (kgraphMapRbPart is G12's 0009).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/common_context.c:272-304 (contextThreadLaunchSplit: randdat seeded from the parent at :298-299), callers: kgraph_map_rb_part.c:316, wgraph_part_rb.c:377 (G12 0009), hgraph_order_nd.c:305, hmesh_order_nd.c:261 (not covered), dgraph_fold_dup.c:166 (no random use)
evidence: common_context.c:290 'spltdat.conttab[1].randptr = &randdat; /* Set independent pseudo-random generator for sub-context 1 */' and :298-299 'intRandProc (&randdat, (int) intRandVal2 (contptr->randptr)); intRandSeed (&randdat, intRandVal2 (contptr->randptr));' ; hgraph_order_nd.c:305 'if (contextThreadLaunchSplit (grafptr->contptr, (ContextSplitFunc) hgraphOrderNd2, &spltdat) != 0)' ; vgraph_separate_gg.c:145 'contextIntRandVal (grafptr->contptr, grafptr->s.vertnbr)); /* Randomly select first root vertex */' ; s_l.tex:7900-7904 'a value of 1 induces a deterministic behavior across multiple runs, for any number of threads (yet, for the same number of MPI processes ...)' ; gmap.c:107 'd : deterministic behavior (even across multiple threads; implies f)'.

fix_options.label: b. Guard the two ordering callers like G12's 0009 guards the two partitioning callers (recommended; extends 0009)
fix_options.summary: hgraph_order_nd.c and hmesh_order_nd.c: include context.h, read CONTEXTOPTIONNUMDETERMINISTIC, run the two sub-tasks in sequence when set ('if ((deteval != 0) || (contextThreadLaunchSplit (...) != 0))'), identical to 0009's hunks.
fix_options.tested: build_alt_b: gord bump.grf identical at 1, 2 and 4 threads under SCOTCH_DETERMINISTIC=1 (0 differing lines); builds with 0 warnings; applies on v7.0.17 (and on top of 0009, different files).
fix_options.tradeoffs: Loses task-level concurrency of nested dissection under the deterministic option (each half still uses all threads for its own threaded work, as graphMatchInit() does); four near-identical guards in the tree.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: The maintainer's idiom for consuming the option is in the algorithm that needs it, with '#include "context.h"' (graph_match.c:57,205-212; dgraph_band_grow.c:403; dgraph_match_sync_ptop.c:222): no common_*.c file includes context.h, the common layer only provides the values mechanism and does not know what value 0 means. Caller-side guards also leave dgraphFoldDup()'s split alone, which consumes no random numbers and would be serialized for nothing by option a.

fix_options.label: a. Refuse to split in contextThreadLaunchSplit() when the deterministic option is set (single point, all five callers)
fix_options.summary: common_context.c: include context.h, read the option, 'return (1)' ('could not split') so every caller takes its sequential fallback; routine comment updated.
fix_options.tested: build_alt_a: gord identical at 1, 2, 4 threads; gpart 2 == 4 threads (1-thread residual = SEP-13); 0 warnings; applies on v7.0.17.
fix_options.tradeoffs: One place instead of five, cannot be forgotten by a future caller; but it makes the common layer depend on libscotch's option numbering (layering) and serializes the PT-Scotch fold-dup split (dgraph_fold_dup.c:166) although it is random-free; makes 0009's guards redundant.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Layering: common_context.c is the generic context code; the deterministic option is a libscotch concept (context.h, contextOptionsInit in context.c).

our_title: Run-time fixed-seed option (and thus the deterministic option) never read: seed stays time-based unless COMMON_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED is compiled in
ran: repro/PS2-G06-1 (build_nofs: 7.0.17, same flags as the ASan tree minus sanitizers and minus -DCOMMON_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED; 1 thread; two gpart 8 bump.grf runs 1.3 s apart): SCOTCH_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED=1 -> 5646/829/4817 differing lines; SCOTCH_DETERMINISTIC=1 -> 0/5646/4817; gpart -Cf -> 4817; -Cd -> 4817; no option -> 9552/829/4817. Same with the ASan tree (compiled with the flag): 0. With alt a applied (build_nofs_alt): all three run-time ways give 0 differing lines in 3 trials each.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/common_integer.c:313-324 (intRandInit), context.c:96-107 (contextOptionsInit), library_context.c:306-323 (SetNum), common_context.c:77-82 (contextInit calls intRandInit before the options exist)
evidence: git grep -n CONTEXTOPTIONNUMRANDOMFIXEDSEED src/libscotch -> context.c:104,105 (read env, store), library_context.c:307,315,337,338 (store), context.h:61, dummysizes.c:288; nothing reads it back. common_integer.c:317-321 '#if ! ((defined COMMON_DEBUG) || (defined COMMON_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED)) contptr->seedval = (INT) time (NULL); #else contptr->seedval = 1;'. README.md:115 documents SCOTCH_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED=1 as 'a fixed pseudo-random seed'; s_l.tex:7913-7918 documents the option the same way.

fix_options.label: a. Reseed the context generator when the option is set (API, Parse, environment); SCOTCH_DETERMINISTIC env implies the fixed seed
fix_options.summary: library_context.c: SetNum(RANDOMFIXEDSEED, 1) calls intRandSeed (randptr, 1) (the COMMON_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED seed); SetNum(DETERMINISTIC, 1) goes through SetNum(RANDOMFIXEDSEED, 1); context.c: contextOptionsInit sets rafival = 1 when deteval != 0 (as the API does) and reseeds when rafival != 0.
fix_options.tested: build_nofs_alt: 0 warnings; -Cf, SCOTCH_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED=1, SCOTCH_DETERMINISTIC=1 all reproducible across runs (3 trials); unconfigured runs still vary.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Behaviour change needing the maintainer's decision: (1) contextOptionsInit runs at every CONTEXTINIT, i.e. at every library call on a plain (non-container) object, so with the option on the shared global generator is reseeded before every call and successive calls on the same graph give identical results, whereas with the compile-time flag the stream continues across calls (SCOTCH_randomReset exists for users who want the restart); (2) reseeding the global generator from one context affects all contexts that use it.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Smallest change that makes the documented knobs do what README.md:115 and s_l.tex:7913 say; whether the run-time option should mean 'seed once per process' (which needs intRandInit to know the option, i.e. moving the random initialization from contextInit() to contextCommit() and giving intRandInit a flag) is his call. Not sent as a commit for that reason.

fix_options.label: b. Honour the option at first generator initialization only
fix_options.summary: Move intRandInit() of the global generator from contextInit() to the first contextCommit()/contextRandomClone() and pass it the option value (seed 1 if fixed, time(NULL) otherwise), so the semantics equal the compile-time flag.
fix_options.tested: untested: no diff; needs an API change of intRandInit() (common layer) and a change of the init order in context.h CONTEXTINIT and SCOTCH_contextInit; the maintainer's design choice.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Exact equivalence with COMMON_RANDOM_FIXED_SEED; but the option value is only known after contextOptionsInit, and the option set later through SCOTCH_contextOptionSetNum would have no effect on an already-initialized generator unless it reseeds (option a).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Cleaner semantics, larger change across common_integer.c / common_context.c / context.h.

our_title: Automatic thread count with a non-NULL coretab reads beyond the table's documented thrdnbr entries
why_not_run: Requires a caller to pass thrdnbr < 0 (or 0 after patches/0001) together with a coretab, which the documentation defines as having thrdnbr entries: a contract violation by the caller rather than a reachable library defect.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/common_thread.c:114-115 with :137-140 (and the same lines after patches/0001 and 0004)
evidence: common_thread.c:114-115 'if (thrdnbr < 0) thrdnbr = corenbr;' then :137-140 'for (thrdnum = 1; thrdnum < thrdnbr; thrdnum ++) { ... corenum = (coretab != NULL) ? (coretab[thrdnum] % corenbr) : ...' ; s_l.tex:8179-8181 'it represents an array of thrdnbr integer values'.

fix_options.label: a. Ignore coretab when the thread number is automatic
fix_options.summary: In threadContextInit(): if thrdnbr <= 0, use the automatic placement (treat coretab as NULL).
fix_options.tested: untested: not drafted (one-line local change, semantics to be confirmed by the maintainer)
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Defensive; consistent with -1/0 meaning 'let Scotch decide'.

fix_options.label: b. Document that coretab requires an explicit thrdnbr
